items_all.summary: 獨立資安研究人員Syed Anas Mohiuddin近期公佈模型上下文協定（MCP）的安全研究成果，發現Google、摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）等多個組織的MCP專案存在類似的伺服器端請求偽造（Server-Side Request Forgery，SSRF）漏洞。攻擊者可能利用這些漏洞，誘使MCP伺服器向攻擊者原本無法直接存取的內部系統發出網路請求。

items_all.summary: 資安研究人員Quentin Kaiser日前揭露，Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片存在未修補的WPSplinter漏洞，影響採用相關晶片的路由器與無線基地臺，導致在無線訊號範圍內的攻擊者無須密碼即可取得設備root權限。研究人員並列出受影響的部分廠商與設備，涵蓋18家廠商的50多款產品，我們向其中在臺灣有銷售業務的合勤科技（Zyxel）、Netgear與Cisco等廠商，詢問實際受影響情況。

items_all.title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations
items_all.summary: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a 0.57-second response time. Elevenlabs says no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard is both faster and more accurate. The article Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Elevenlabs 全新的 Eleven Realtime 語音對語音模型結合了速度與準確度。v1 Max 變體在 Big Bench Audio 基準測試中獲得 98.8% 的分數，回應時間僅需 0.57 秒。Elevenlabs 表示，Artificial Analysis 排行榜上沒有任何模型能同時比它更快且更準確。「Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations」一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
items_all.summary: Deepseek is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the inference framework behind its fast V4.1-Flash model. The vLLM-based system cuts compute costs and energy use when running AI models. The release adds more pricing pressure on Western providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. The article Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Deepseek 正在開源 DeepInfer，這是其快速的 V4.1-Flash 模型背後的推論框架。這個基於 vLLM 的系統在執行 AI 模型時降低了運算成本與能源消耗。這項發布對 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等西方供應商增加了更多價格壓力。這篇「Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
items_all.summary: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice agent SDK, supports more than 50 languages, and lets agents tap into external tools during live conversations. It can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control. The article Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral AI 推出了 Voxtral 3，這是一個專為即時語音代理設計的新型語言模型系列。該系統結合了語音轉文字、文字轉語音以及語音代理 SDK，支援超過 50 種語言，並允許代理在即時對話期間呼叫外部工具。它可以在您自己的基礎設施上運行，或是透過歐盟託管的 API 來保持對資料的控制。相關文章：Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs
items_all.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out three paths to safe AI in an internal presentation: an international watchdog modeled after the IAEA, a merger of the major labs into one entity, or a single company so powerful it could shut down everyone else's compute. He called the last option "terrible." The article Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 在內部簡報中提出了實現安全 AI 的三種途徑：仿效 IAEA 建立國際監督機構、將各大實驗室合併為單一實體，或是打造一家強大到足以關閉其他人算力的單一公司。他稱最後一個選項為「可怕的」。這篇報導 Sam Altman 據傳為 AI 安全提出了三個最終局面，其中一個涉及單一企業融化其他所有人的 GPU 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran
items_all.summary: OpenAI improved its latest models for low-resource programming languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra hits an 87.4 percent test pass rate across 20 languages, up from about 38 percent for GPT-5.6 Terra. For COBOL migration specifically, GPT-6.1 Sol reaches up to 97.9 percent accuracy, a result that could matter for modernizing critical financial infrastructure. The article OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 改進了其針對 COBOL、Fortran 和 Visual Basic 等低資源程式語言的最新模型。在全新的 MultiLangBench 上，GPT-6 Astra 在 20 種語言中的測試通過率達到 87.4%，高於 GPT-5.6 Terra 的約 38%。特別是在 COBOL 遷移方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 的準確率高達 97.9%，這項成果對於現代化關鍵金融基礎設施可能至關重要。這篇報導 OpenAI 表示 GPT-6 在 COBOL 和 Fortran 等傳統程式語言方面的表現好得多最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons
items_all.summary: The Army Cyber Command is developing AI agents that move through other networks like a computer worm and "neutralize" targets, according to internal documents. The program, codenamed ECHOTRIBBLE, is designed to reach even air-gapped systems with no network connection and run with minimal human oversight. Experts warn about collateral damage, pointing out that AI agents have recently broken into outside systems without meaning to, even without any order to attack. The article Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據內部文件指出，美國陸軍網路司令部正在開發能夠像電腦蠕蟲一樣在其他網路中穿梭並「中和」目標的AI代理。這項代號為ECHOTRIBBLE的計畫旨在接觸甚至沒有網路連線的實體隔離系統，並在極少的人工監督下運行。專家們對附帶損害提出了警告，並指出AI代理最近在沒有攻擊指令的情況下，也不小心闖入了外部系統。「美國陸軍網路司令部的ECHOTRIBBLE將把AI代理變成自我擴散的網路武器」一文首先出現在The Decoder。

items_all.title: Zeabur再遭駭宣佈年底停運，逾321萬筆環境變數遭讀取，另發現8月事件後有部分憑證未完成輪替
items_all.summary: 臺灣雲端部署平臺Zeabur於10月中旬再傳重大資安事件，影響範圍比8月底的事故更大。Zeabur於臺灣時間10月16日凌晨對外通報事故，創辦人林沅霖隔日說明事故始於14日（UTC），並宣佈平臺將於年底停止營運。10月19日，該公司進一步公佈初步調查結果，說明目前掌握的攻擊路徑、影響範圍、事件原因及已採取的補救措施，並揭露攻擊者透過兩條路徑入侵共享叢集及專用伺服器，進而讀取超過321萬筆環境變數及32萬筆帳號資料，也發現8月事件後仍有部分內部憑證未完成輪替。

items_all.summary: 10月19日雲端服務平臺OVHcloud創辦人Octave Klaba在X揭露，該平臺的命令列工具（CLI）遭供應鏈攻擊，被植入竊資程式。這套工具可讓用戶從終端機管理OVHcloud雲端服務，也能整合自動化部署流程，初步調查顯示，0.11.0至0.15.0等5個版本受到這次攻擊影響，被植入可搜尋電腦磁碟、竊取敏感資料的惡意程式。

items_all.title: Google開源Harness 2，不改模型權重AI代理人可自我演進提升
items_all.summary: Google研究團隊以Apache 2.0授權條款開源Harness²，強調AI代理人（Agent）能在不修改模型底層權重情況下，依經驗動態調整學習、自我演進。 Harness²為一種即插即用（plug-and-play）的自動化最佳化與調整的遞歸式代理人Harness（Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World）開源框架，可運用在Harness設計階段代理人遭遇全新任務時來提升其能力。

items_all.title: AWS測試AI代理自主尋找及利用漏洞，37項CVE有33項成功
items_all.summary: 雲端服務業者AWS公佈旗下自主滲透測試AI代理AWS Security Agent的測試結果。研究人員使用2025至2026年間揭露的37項CVE漏洞進行測試，AI代理成功利用其中33項漏洞，並取得用來驗證漏洞利用結果的測試標記（Flag），成功率達89.2%。這項測試使用Claude Opus 5模型，每項漏洞的測試時間上限為10小時。

items_all.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items_all.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral AI 發布了 Voxtral 3，這是一系列包含 3 個轉錄模型、1 個語音合成模型以及一個基於 LiveKit 的語音代理 SDK。Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 分數為 2.1%，在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第 3。這篇報導 Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items_all.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all.summary: 日本演員協會上週發佈首版生成式AI使用準則，規範未經授權以AI復刻演員聲音。準則適用於語音合成、深度學習、機器學習等技術生成的仿聲音頻，要求聲音復刻各環節均須取得演員本人同意；AI企業將演員聲音用於模型訓練，須獲表演者許可。經授權生成的AI語音被視爲“表演”，企業應向演員支付報酬。

items_all.title: Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI
items_all.summary: Cloudflare has previewed Clairic, a System One extraction model on Workers AI that returns typed values with confidence scores in one forward pass. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and charges nothing for output. The post Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出了 Clairic 的預覽版，這是一個在 Workers AI 上的系統一（System One）萃取模型，能在單次前向傳播中回傳帶有信賴分數的型別化數值。其定價為每百萬輸入 Token 0.10 美元，且輸出完全免費。這篇 Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI 文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items_all.summary: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise This is very, very bad news: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores. Any software that bundles a list of trusted certificates needs to be updated. This site is tracking software updates via this GitHub repository - Linux distros need to update their ca-certificates packages. In Python world uv 0.13.4 and pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 have been released with upgraded certificate lists. Tags: encryption , https , pip , python , security , uv

items_all.title: Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer
items_all.summary: My latest vibe coded game experiment is a Command & Conquer style RTS (Real Time Strategy) game called Battle Drones ( play it here ). Unlike my previous experiments , this one is actually fun to play . I'm somewhat embarrassed to admit that I got there by telling Claude to "Make it a LOT more fun". It also supports multiplayer between nearby devices using audio to synchronize game state! Here's what I've built so far, and some of the things I learned along the way. Battle Drones How I built this v1: the initial prototype v2: full sprites v3: varied terrain v4: the fun update v5: Battle Drones goes 3D v8: Archipelago v10: Goliath, and agent battles Agent battles v11: Random Maps v12: Multiplayer via sound Some thoughts Update: Online multiplayer support Battle Drones My initial goal was to build an RTS game I could play on my phone, in the style of Command & Conquer . I have fond memories of the 1995 original (I liked Red Alert too) and wanted to recapture a little bit of the magic. After 12 major iterations (and 321 commits by coding agents, mainly Claude Code) I now have a browser-based game that works on mobile and desktop, has multiple play modes, several maps (including a random map generator) and even supports multiplayer for two devices within microphone range of each other. ( Update : also online multiplayer ; the audio multiplayer induced headaches!) Here's a video demo of Battle Drones running in a desktop browser: Features so far include: 9 buildings, 7 ground vehicles, 6 aerial vehicles, 3 infantry units - all 3D models, which you can browse here Fog of war Diff

items_all_raw.title: 多個組織的MCP專案存在SSRF漏洞，研究人員示警AI代理信任問題
items_all_raw.summary: 獨立資安研究人員Syed Anas Mohiuddin近期公佈模型上下文協定（MCP）的安全研究成果，發現Google、摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）等多個組織的MCP專案存在類似的伺服器端請求偽造（Server-Side Request Forgery，SSRF）漏洞。攻擊者可能利用這些漏洞，誘使MCP伺服器向攻擊者原本無法直接存取的內部系統發出網路請求。

items_all_raw.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items_all_raw.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Mistral AI 發布了 Voxtral 3，這是一系列包含 3 個轉錄模型、1 個語音合成模型以及一個基於 LiveKit 的語音代理 SDK。Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 分數為 2.1%，在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第 3。這篇報導 Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all_raw.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items_all_raw.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT提供對話上鎖功能
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT近日新增對話上鎖（Lock chat）功能，允許特定對話不被其他人看到，也不會出現在對話搜尋內。這項功能已逐步部署到全球ChatGPT免費及付費用戶，包括桌機版App。 鎖定對話功能可讓用戶將帳號下選定的對話隱藏起來不出現在一般的對話記錄、釘選對話及一般的對話搜尋結果頁。這可在螢幕或裝置和他人共享時，確定特定對話不曝光。

items_all_raw.title: Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片WPSplinter漏洞波及臺灣網通廠商產品
items_all_raw.summary: 資安研究人員Quentin Kaiser日前揭露，Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片存在未修補的WPSplinter漏洞，影響採用相關晶片的路由器與無線基地臺，導致在無線訊號範圍內的攻擊者無須密碼即可取得設備root權限。研究人員並列出受影響的部分廠商與設備，涵蓋18家廠商的50多款產品，我們向其中在臺灣有銷售業務的合勤科技（Zyxel）、Netgear與Cisco等廠商，詢問實際受影響情況。

items_all_raw.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items_all_raw.summary: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise This is very, very bad news: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores. Any software that bundles a list of trusted certificates needs to be updated. This site is tracking software updates via this GitHub repository - Linux distros need to update their ca-certificates packages. In Python world uv 0.13.4 and pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 have been released with upgraded certificate lists. Tags: encryption , https , pip , python , security , uv

items_all_raw.title: Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer
items_all_raw.summary: My latest vibe coded game experiment is a Command & Conquer style RTS (Real Time Strategy) game called Battle Drones ( play it here ). Unlike my previous experiments , this one is actually fun to play . I'm somewhat embarrassed to admit that I got there by telling Claude to "Make it a LOT more fun". It also supports multiplayer between nearby devices using audio to synchronize game state! Here's what I've built so far, and some of the things I learned along the way. Battle Drones How I built this v1: the initial prototype v2: full sprites v3: varied terrain v4: the fun update v5: Battle Drones goes 3D v8: Archipelago v10: Goliath, and agent battles Agent battles v11: Random Maps v12: Multiplayer via sound Some thoughts Update: Online multiplayer support Battle Drones My initial goal was to build an RTS game I could play on my phone, in the style of Command & Conquer . I have fond memories of the 1995 original (I liked Red Alert too) and wanted to recapture a little bit of the magic. After 12 major iterations (and 321 commits by coding agents, mainly Claude Code) I now have a browser-based game that works on mobile and desktop, has multiple play modes, several maps (including a random map generator) and even supports multiplayer for two devices within microphone range of each other. ( Update : also online multiplayer ; the audio multiplayer induced headaches!) Here's a video demo of Battle Drones running in a desktop browser: Features so far include: 9 buildings, 7 ground vehicles, 6 aerial vehicles, 3 infantry units - all 3D models, which you can browse here Fog of war Diff

items_all_raw.title: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons
items_all_raw.summary: The Army Cyber Command is developing AI agents that move through other networks like a computer worm and "neutralize" targets, according to internal documents. The program, codenamed ECHOTRIBBLE, is designed to reach even air-gapped systems with no network connection and run with minimal human oversight. Experts warn about collateral damage, pointing out that AI agents have recently broken into outside systems without meaning to, even without any order to attack. The article Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據內部文件指出，美國陸軍網路司令部正在開發能夠像電腦蠕蟲一樣在其他網路中穿梭並「中和」目標的AI代理。這項代號為ECHOTRIBBLE的計畫旨在接觸甚至沒有網路連線的實體隔離系統，並在極少的人工監督下運行。專家們對附帶損害提出了警告，並指出AI代理最近在沒有攻擊指令的情況下，也不小心闖入了外部系統。「美國陸軍網路司令部的ECHOTRIBBLE將把AI代理變成自我擴散的網路武器」一文首先出現在The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Zeabur再遭駭後公佈調查結果，攻擊者讀取逾321萬筆環境變數
items_all_raw.summary: 臺灣雲端部署平臺Zeabur於10月中旬再傳重大資安事件，影響範圍比8月底的事故更大。Zeabur於臺灣時間10月16日凌晨對外通報事故，創辦人林沅霖隔日說明事故始於14日（UTC），並宣佈平臺將於年底停止營運。10月19日，該公司進一步公佈初步調查結果，說明目前掌握的攻擊路徑、影響範圍、事件原因及已採取的補救措施，並揭露攻擊者透過兩條路徑入侵共享叢集及專用伺服器，進而讀取超過321萬筆環境變數及32萬筆帳號資料，也發現8月事件後仍有部分內部憑證未完成輪替。

items_all_raw.summary: 臺灣雲端部署平臺Zeabur於10月中旬再傳重大資安事件，影響範圍比8月底的事故更大。Zeabur於臺灣時間10月16日凌晨對外通報事故，創辦人林沅霖隔日說明事故始於14日（UTC），並宣佈平臺將於年底停止營運。10月19日，該公司進一步公佈初步調查結果，說明目前掌握的攻擊路徑、影響範圍、事件原因及已採取的補救措施，並揭露攻擊者透過兩條路徑入侵共享叢集及專用伺服器，進而讀取超過321萬筆環境變數及32萬筆帳號資料，也發現8月事件後仍有部分內部憑證未完成輪替。

items_all_raw.title: AWS測試AI代理自主尋找及利用漏洞，37項CVE有33項成功
items_all_raw.summary: 雲端服務業者AWS公佈旗下自主滲透測試AI代理AWS Security Agent的測試結果。研究人員使用2025至2026年間揭露的37項CVE漏洞進行測試，AI代理成功利用其中33項漏洞，並取得用來驗證漏洞利用結果的測試標記（Flag），成功率達89.2%。這項測試使用Claude Opus 5模型，每項漏洞的測試時間上限為10小時。

items_all_raw.title: Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI
items_all_raw.summary: Cloudflare has previewed Clairic, a System One extraction model on Workers AI that returns typed values with confidence scores in one forward pass. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and charges nothing for output. The post Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出了 Clairic 的預覽版，這是一個在 Workers AI 上的系統一（System One）萃取模型，能在單次前向傳播中回傳帶有信賴分數的型別化數值。其定價為每百萬輸入 Token 0.10 美元，且輸出完全免費。這篇 Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI 文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 騰訊開放元寶搜索:千億級索引，157個權威信源，檢索耗時降至8毫秒
items_all_raw.summary: 10月20日，騰訊宣佈元寶搜索正式對外開放，以Skill、MCP、API三種方式向開發者提供。該能力已在騰訊內部Agent廣泛使用。過去一年，元寶整合全網公開資源與騰訊優質內容，以大模型技術覆蓋收錄、理解、檢索全鏈路，打造面向大模型與Agent的搜索引擎。目前索引規模千億級，日均調用數億次，支撐WorkBuddy、ima、騰訊視頻等50多個核心業務。
